## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant UI checked at the 720 × 480 minimum window size
- [ ] Tests and documentation updated where needed
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated build output, or desktop captures included
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`)

## Screenshots

Include deliberately staged, app-only screenshots for visual changes. Do not
include the macOS desktop, menu bar, Dock, personal files, or private chats.
